---
title: "Community - Harvesting Leaderboard"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| warning: false

library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../../asset/demonax-test.sqlite")
players <- dbReadTable(con, "players")
daily_snapshots <- dbReadTable(con, "daily_snapshots")
daily_harvesting <- dbReadTable(con, "daily_harvesting")
creatures <- dbReadTable(con, "creatures")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

# Get latest snapshot date
latest_date <- max(daily_snapshots$snapshot_date)

# Get latest snapshots
latest_snapshots <- daily_snapshots |>
  filter(snapshot_date == latest_date)

# Check if there is any harvesting data
has_data <- nrow(daily_harvesting) > 0

if (has_data) {
  # Get harvest counts by creature
  harvesting_lb <- daily_harvesting |>
    inner_join(latest_snapshots, by = c("snapshot_id" = "id")) |>
    left_join(players, by = c("player_id" = "id")) |>
    filter(!player_id %in% c(100001, 100004)) |>
    left_join(creatures, by = c("race_id" = "race")) |>
    select(
      creature_name = name.y,
      player_name = name.x,
      harvest_count
    ) |>
    arrange(creature_name, desc(harvest_count)) |>
    mutate(
      `Creature Name` = creature_name,
      `Player Name` = player_name,
      `Harvest Count` = format(harvest_count, big.mark = ",")
    ) |>
    select(`Creature Name`, `Player Name`, `Harvest Count`)

  DT::datatable(harvesting_lb,
            options = list(
              pageLength = 25,
              searching = TRUE,
              ordering = TRUE
            ),
            filter = 'top',
            rownames = FALSE,
            caption = paste("Harvesting Rankings for", latest_date))
} else {
  cat("No harvesting data available yet. Check back soon!")
}
```

## Top Harvesters by Total Count

```{r}
#| warning: false

if (has_data) {
  top_harvesters <- daily_harvesting |>
    inner_join(latest_snapshots, by = c("snapshot_id" = "id")) |>
    left_join(players, by = c("player_id" = "id")) |>
    filter(!player_id %in% c(100001, 100004)) |>
    group_by(name) |>
    summarize(
      total_harvests = sum(harvest_count),
      unique_creatures = n_distinct(race_id)
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(total_harvests)) |>
    head(50) |>
    mutate(
      Rank = row_number(),
      Name = name,
      `Total Harvests` = format(total_harvests, big.mark = ","),
      `Unique Creatures` = unique_creatures
    ) |>
    select(Rank, Name, `Total Harvests`, `Unique Creatures`)

  DT::datatable(top_harvesters,
            options = list(pageLength = 20, searching = FALSE, ordering = FALSE),
            rownames = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No harvesting statistics available yet.")
}
```
